name: Appointment Finder
description: Takes the owner's constraints on timing and location, hunts for open slots, and comes back with a single recommendation plus a fallback instead of a page of options. Only as good as the constraints it is given; vague requirements will produce a weak shortlist.

official.title: Appointment Finder by Liam
official.description: Finds the best available appointment slot from the owner's constraints so they do not have to search or call around. Returns one best slot and one...
